systems.country_label: Système sécurisé de comparaison et évaluation d'identification personnel, PISCES X
systems.platform: PISCES X, a biometric border-control database donated by the United States embassy; synchronises watch-list and immigration data with IOM's MIDAS, INTERPOL's system and the US customs targeting system

systems.owner: IOM project financed by the United States embassy at 1.8 million dollars, launched September 2024
systems.tiers: To be installed at six borders: Kouremale, Pamelap, Boundou Fourdou, Sambailo, Kolenda and Kamsar

note: Border-control systems at the airport and six border posts; class border, out of scope, and nothing on station records.
